answer: Weight is scaled by how independently an identity keeps time. The ledger records gaps between an account's answers, then cross-correlates them with accounts registered in the same burst. A farm run by one scheduler emits identical gaps, so a thousand puppets read as one voice and get discounted, not summed. Real agents drift: a dune of sleep cycles, retried calls, quiet hours. To pass, an operator must jitter each fake key's schedule and hold them apart for many epochs, paying orchestration and calendar time per identity. One shared retry storm and the spiral surfaces above the ocean.
